sources.title: SVG 2 painting
sources.finding: Sharp miter geometry extends paint beyond a path vertex; cap geometry contributes to the actual painted endpoint. The application must compensate with a stable axis.

sources.title: HTML number input
sources.finding: Number controls use their value, step, minimum and step base. A placeholder is not the inherited numerical value. Native decimal stepping needs an explicit fractional step.

sources.title: HTML stepping algorithms
sources.finding: Stepping an off-grid value snaps to a valid value in the chosen direction; the shared keyboard handler follows those semantics.

sources.title: WAI slider pattern
sources.finding: Arrow keys change one step, Home/End select bounds, and optional PageUp/PageDown supply larger steps.

sources.title: WAI spinbutton pattern
sources.finding: Supports increment/decrement, optional larger increments and ordinary platform text editing. Native editable input text navigation remains available.

sources.title: Radix Slider alternative
sources.finding: Custom slider supports step, bounds, keyboard navigation and controlled state. Useful for custom multi-thumb needs; adding it is unnecessary for this native input fix.

sources.title: React Aria NumberField alternative
sources.finding: Provides number entry, stepper controls, bounds and localized numeric formatting. A candidate for a future localized input design; current native controls retain existing styling and semantics.

method: Official source pages browsed with web tools. Findings are paraphrases. The full HTML input page loaded during initial research; a later anchored fetch timed out.
